experiment: Separate detector for small items only (Lighter, Bullet); its dense scores replace E1's for those items

small_items.rule: train box side (sqrt of area) at 640 input, median below 100 px

change: labels keep Lighter and Bullet only on train and val; all images kept, other items become background; class names and indices unchanged

scores.extraction: predict_dense_scores.py, batch 32, imgsz 960 (same as the 960 control)
scores.combine: fuse_scores.py --select use: Lighter and Bullet from the small model, the other 10 items from E1

E1+960.note: 12-item model, same imgsz 960 and pretrained start; separates the effect of training apart from resolution

E1+small.dense: Lighter and Bullet from the small model

gate.setting: F, cap 5%, delta 0.05/36, seeds 0-9, dense scores, arm E1+small

also_report: recall by size bin per item (size_recall.py, conf 0.25)
second model doubles inference per image
caveat: The gate reads the repeatedly used PIDray test set, so a pass is exploratory and not independent validation. Thresholds in this file are fixed before training and are not changed after seeing results.
